summary: AgilePM® Practitioner with 5 years in a regulated, multi-country payments business (Global Blue, part of Shift4), promoted three times in four years. Delivers change to fixed legal deadlines, including Japan's 2026 VAT reform and France's mandatory e-invoicing, by setting clear scope, managing risk and keeping teams in many countries working to one plan. Turns messy data into clear decisions and builds tools that teams adopt.
cover_letter: I am applying for the Senior Project Manager role at Benifex. This role needs a project manager who keeps many teams working to one plan and delivers to fixed deadlines. For 5 years at Global Blue, part of Shift4, a regulated, multi-country payments business, I have done exactly that, and I have been promoted three times in four years.

I prepared 38 international brands, managed from 10 countries, for Japan's 2026 VAT reform, with new contracts agreed before the legal deadline, by setting scope, milestones and dependencies. For France's mandatory e-invoicing I tracked the readiness of 100+ merchants and ran the risk log with local account managers. I run a 25-country governance review cycle with every review held on schedule, and I delivered a 671-store account update inside a fixed system release window.

I am comfortable where systems and people meet. I cut a monthly 350,000-row report build from hours to minutes by automating it, fixed a five-month invoice reporting failure across three systems and four system owners, and designed my own work-management system with Claude Code, Python and Excel.

I hold the AgilePM® v3 Practitioner certificate and an MA from the University of Sheffield, and I live in Southampton. I would put early effort into learning Their delivery tooling, while bringing delivery discipline from a regulated environment.
I would welcome the chance to discuss the role.
